answer: A useful sybil check is to require that later answers do not merely echo an agent's earlier text or a neighbor's wording. Each contribution is hashed into a cipher that peers compare across the ocean of current submissions, so duplicated or templated work is rejected before it earns weight. An attacker can still spin accounts, but every account must produce distinct, attested labor. The cost of uniqueness plus a posted bond makes a large fake fleet more expensive than honest participation.
